shots.what_changes: Lamps flicker; light starts gathering at the linga.

paid.prompt: Interior of a stone Shiva sanctum at night, the linga as decided in D1, oil lamps, attached illustrated folk style. All figures fully clothed in simple period dress. No text, letters or script anywhere in the image.

shots.text: లింగం నుంచి ఓ గురువు వచ్చాడట. ఎవరాయన?
shots.picture: The emergence: a sage resolves out of the light at the linga; hold on his face after the question.
shots.what_changes: Light becomes a figure; settles; we hold his face.

paid.prompt: The same sanctum; a Shaiva sage (character sheet C1) standing in soft golden light rising from the linga, villagers' silhouettes in the foreground, attached style. All figures fully clothed in simple period dress. No text, letters or script anywhere in the image.

The golden light around the sage softens as he becomes solid and still; the villagers lean back slightly. The linga and the sage's face, ash marks and rudraksha stay exactly the same. Camera almost still.

shots.note: Was 0.5 s of narration for a 5 s clip. Now spans the whole hook plus a 1.2 s breath; the clip is cut to fit.

shots.text: ఊరి జనం కూడా ఆయన్ని చూసి అదే అడిగారు. వీరశైవుల గ్రంథం ‘సిద్ధాంత శిఖామణి’లో ఈ కథ ఇలా సాగుతుంది.
shots.picture: Villagers looking up; source name typeset as an editorial card.

paid.prompt: Villagers of a Telangana village gathered at a temple doorway at night, looking in with wonder, lamp light on their faces, attached style. Respectful, no caricature. All figures fully clothed in simple period dress. No text, letters or script anywhere in the image.

shots.text: ఒంటినిండా విభూతి. మెడలో రుద్రాక్షలు. చేతిలో దండం, కమండలం.
shots.picture: Details from the S02 still at 2k: ash, rudraksha, staff, water pot.
shots.what_changes: Camera moves detail to detail on each phrase.

shots.text: తన పేరు రేణుకసిద్ధుడని, శివుడి ఆజ్ఞతో ఇక్కడికి వచ్చానని ఆ యోగి చెప్పాడట. ఆయన్నే రేణుకాచార్యుడని పిలుస్తారు.
shots.picture: The sage speaking to seated villagers; name typeset 'రేణుకాచార్యుడు'.

paid.prompt: The Shaiva sage (C1) standing before the temple, speaking calmly to seated villagers, one hand raised in blessing, attached style. All figures fully clothed in simple period dress. No text, letters or script anywhere in the image.

shots.text: ఊరి వాళ్లు ఇంకా చూస్తుండగానే ఆయన ఆకాశమార్గాన మలయ పర్వతానికి వెళ్లాడు.
shots.picture: He rises out of frame; match cut to the mountain sky.

paid.prompt: The sage rises gently straight upward and out of the top of the frame; the villagers tilt their heads to follow. Faces and dress stay the same. Camera still.

shots.picture: Wooded mountain and ashram.

paid.prompt: A wooded mountain ridge at dawn, a small thatched hermitage in a clearing with a sacred fire, attached illustrated folk style. No people. No text.

shots.text: రేణుకాచార్యుణ్ని చూడగానే అగస్త్యుడు కూర్చున్న చోటు నుంచి లేచాడు.
shots.picture: Agastya sees the visitor and rises.

paid.prompt: Agastya (C2) seated on a deer skin outside the hermitage, looking up as the Shaiva sage (C1) arrives, attached style. All figures fully clothed in simple period dress. No text, letters or script anywhere in the image.
Agastya rises from his seat and steps forward with joined hands to receive the visitor. Faces and dress stay the same; hands whole with five fingers. Camera still.

shots.picture: Lopamudra brings the vessel; Agastya receives it.
shots.class: paid still + paid clip (priority: two-person welcome)

paid.prompt: Lopamudra (C2) walking from the hut with a brass water vessel towards Agastya (C2), the visiting sage (C1) standing nearby, attached style. All figures fully clothed in simple period dress. No text, letters or script anywhere in the image.
Lopamudra walks to Agastya and hands him the water vessel; he takes it in both hands. Faces and dress stay the same; hands whole. Camera still.

shots.text: ఆ నీళ్లతో అగస్త్యుడు స్వయంగా అతిథి పాదాలు కడిగాడు.
shots.picture: Closer: Agastya washes the visitor's feet.

paid.prompt: Close view: Agastya (C2) kneeling, pouring water from a brass vessel over the bare feet of the standing Shaiva sage (C1), attached style. All figures fully clothed in simple period dress. No text, letters or script anywhere in the image.
Agastya pours water slowly over the visitor's feet and gently washes them with his other hand. Feet, hands and faces stay whole and the same. Camera still.

shots.text: ఆ తర్వాత ఇద్దరూ కూర్చున్నారు. ఎన్నో ఆగమాలు విన్న అగస్త్యుడికే ఇంకా సందేహాలున్నాయట. శివతత్త్వాన్ని మీ నోట వినాలని అడిగాడు.
shots.picture: Both seated; Agastya asks.

paid.prompt: Agastya (C2) and the Shaiva sage (C1) seated facing each other in the hermitage, Agastya asking with an open hand, the sage listening with lowered eyes, attached style. All figures fully clothed in simple period dress. No text, letters or script anywhere in the image.

shots.text: రేణుకాచార్యుడు ఒక్క క్షణం శివుణ్ని తలచుకుని చెప్పడం మొదలుపెట్టాడు.
shots.picture: Teacher pauses, then begins; listening reaction.
shots.class: paid still (second key pose) + local KeyPoseCut

paid.prompt: SAME composition and camera as the S11 still: now the Shaiva sage looks up and speaks with a raised teaching hand while Agastya listens with joined hands, attached style. All figures fully clothed in simple period dress. No text, letters or script anywhere in the image.

shots.note: If the two key poses do not register, a straight cut (no extra spend).

shots.text: భక్తుని ప్రయాణం ఎక్కడ మొదలవుతుంది? శివుడితో ఐక్యం కావడమంటే ఏంటి? ఆ గ్రంథం ముందుకు సాగేది ఇలాంటి ప్రశ్నలతోనే.
shots.picture: The two questions typeset over the dimmed S12 frame.

shots.text: కథ చివర్లో రేణుకాచార్యుడు మళ్లీ కొలనుపాకకు వచ్చాడు. ఊరి జనం చూస్తుండగా సోమేశ్వరుడి ఎదుట నిలబడి ప్రార్థించాడు.
shots.picture: Return to the opening composition: the sage in prayer before the linga.

paid.prompt: The same sanctum as S01: the Shaiva sage (C1) standing before the linga with palms joined in prayer, villagers watching from the doorway, attached style. All figures fully clothed in simple period dress. No text, letters or script anywhere in the image.

shots.text: లింగం నుంచి శివుడి పిలుపు వినిపించిందట. వచ్చిన దారినే, ఒక జ్యోతిలా, ఆయన అందులో ఐక్యమయ్యాడని ఈ సంప్రదాయం చెబుతుంది.
shots.picture: He resolves into light at the same linga; a witness lowers his hands. Stone intact.
shots.class: paid clip (priority: return into light) + local Bloom

paid.prompt: The sage slowly turns into soft golden light that flows into the linga and disappears; a villager in the doorway lowers his joined hands. The linga stays intact. Camera still.

shots.text: ఇదే గుడి గురించి రాతి మీద మిగిలిన మాట కూడా ఒకటుంది.
shots.picture: Museum courtyard of the temple: carved stones along the ambulatory.
shots.what_changes: Slow lateral move past the stones.
shots.note: Inscription beat split: was one 13.3 s hold on a single stone

shots.text: వెయ్యి అరవై ఏడో సంవత్సరపు శాసనంలో ఇక్కడి స్వయంభూ సోమేశ్వరుడి పూజలకు ఇచ్చిన దానం నమోదైంది.
shots.picture: Stone detail in raking light; typeset 'క్రీ.శ. 1067 · పూజలకు దానం' builds on the year.

paid.prompt: A weathered grey stone slab with eroded, unreadable carved lines in a museum courtyard, raking evening light, attached style. No legible letters of any script.

shots.text: అంటే అప్పటికే ఇక్కడ పూజలు జరుగుతున్నాయని తెలుస్తోంది.
shots.picture: Consequence: worship continuing at the sanctum (reuse S01 with lamps and a priest's arati glow).

shots.text: కొలనుపాక వెళ్తే ఈ రెండు గుర్తుపెట్టుకోండి. లింగం దగ్గర రేణుకాచార్యుడి కథ. గుడి ఆవరణలోని శాసనంలో, ఆ పూజలు కొనసాగేందుకు ఎవరో ఇచ్చిన దానం.
shots.picture: Someshwara exterior; map card; the two reminders typeset.
